question: What excellent power is gained by performing a hundred oblations?
premises: This produces excellent subjugation of the Kalis.
inference: A hundred oblations yield excellent subjugation of the Kalis.
uncertainties: kālīnāṃ may refer to Kālī goddesses or female beings associated with Kālī; context suggests subjugation of powerful female forces.
plain_english: By a hundred oblations, one gains the excellent subjugation of the Kalis.
